trap-negation-contrast.evidence: 1 negation-contrast construction(s): "not a M -deformation artefact but" — state the positive claim directly

'is **not** a $q$-deformation artefact but a structural feature of $\Phi_1$ in the symmetric group algebra' is the diagnostic's actual finding (the wrong-sign binding survives the $q \to 1$ limit), i.e. substantive contrast.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Full read of the proof plus the companion-reading and diagnostic-application sections. no setup-then-reframe pivot.

trap-em-dash.evidence: Full read of the proof plus the companion-reading and diagnostic-application sections. em-dash use is ranges/true parentheticals only, not load-bearing.

trap-triples.evidence: Full read of the proof plus the companion-reading and diagnostic-application sections. no reflex three-item list; enumerations are substantive.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: Full read of the proof plus the companion-reading and diagnostic-application sections. final line is technical/cross-reference, not a quotable closer.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric
Full read of the proof plus the companion-reading and diagnostic-application sections. no narrating of own emphasis.

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: Full read of the proof plus the companion-reading and diagnostic-application sections. no block-final restatement of what the text established.

trap-performed-warmth.evidence: Full read of the proof plus the companion-reading and diagnostic-application sections. institutional register; no personal warmth vocabulary.

trap-superlative.evidence: Full read of the proof plus the companion-reading and diagnostic-application sections. claims are qualified; no maximum-strength inflation.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: 'canonical scan\n(the formal derivation) confirms that the proton--neutron mass splitting *vanishes* ...' -- two token substitutions in one subject phrase ('canonical scan' for a numerical scan, '(the formal derivation)' where a script name stood), leaving the sentence without an identifiable agent.
